title: Chapter 243 Beat Him Up Directly
content:
Chapter 243 Beat Him Up Directly

In this way, Lu Daosheng took the two of them away from the Fire Immortal Realm and headed straight to the deserted city.

With this Shi Liantian, I believe that even if the Huangcheng City does not have its own help, it will develop extremely rapidly in the future.

And while Lu Daosheng left Huangcheng, a special guest came to Huangcheng.

"Huh? I didn't expect that there was a strange city in this Wood Fairy World?"

In front of the gate of Huangcheng City, an old man in a long robe and red-haired eyebrows looked at the giant city in front of him, and couldn't help but sigh.

But when the old man thought of the person who refined the elixir above the Immortal Emperor Pill, he suddenly felt that it was normal.

If the other party stays in a very ordinary place, it will be strange.

After pondering for a moment, Jordan Yang stepped into the deserted city with great strides.

Walking on the streets of the deserted city, Jordanyang was shocked again.

In the entire city, countless tedious auras were constantly intertwined.

The void on the city is full of terrifying laws of forbidden air.

Even as a peak powerhouse in the Immortal Emperor Realm, he couldn't help but feel fear when he felt the power of the law.

Looking at the facilities in the city, they are basically made of rare materials.

Even the ones laying under their feet were genuine fairy stones.

So proud?

At this moment, as a top alchemist who is well-known and highly respected in the Immortal Realm, he actually feels like he has become a native dog.

After wiping the cold sweat on his forehead, Jordanyang's mood gradually changed.

It seems that I have come to a remarkable place.

I don’t know what status and status the person I’m looking for is in this city.

Half a day later.

"A alchemist?"

In the city lord's mansion, Xun Heng stood respectfully in front of Wan Feng reporting on his work.

When Wanfeng heard that an alchemist wanted to see their city lord, Wanfeng immediately stood up.

"Did the alchemist come from the Immortal Realm?"

Wanfeng hurriedly said, seemingly excited in his tone.

Feeling Wan Feng’s emotions, Xun Heng continued to say, “This, Lord Wan, that person didn’t say it. He just said that he was an alchemist and wanted to meet the city lord.”

Speaking of this, Xun Heng was silent for a moment and hesitated: "Master Wan, this is not a liar, right?"

Hearing this, Wan Feng's mouth slightly raised.

The master just told her that there is an alchemist coming now. Who else can he be if he is not.

You know, she has been in the Wood Immortal Realm for so many years, and there are not many who dare to call herself an alchemist.

Most of them just call themselves alchemists because they are not qualified enough and can only refine some low-level pills and basic healing pills, with very little effect.

Now, a guy who calls himself an alchemist comes.

For a moment, Wanfeng also became interested.

Of course, the most important thing is that she really wants to see what kind of person is the alchemist whom her master specifically told her to "take good care of" her.

"Let him come to see me."

Upon hearing this, Xun Heng nodded quickly and said, "Master Wan, let's do it now."

After a moment.

Wan Feng sat upright in the yard, and Xun Heng soon came back.

Behind him was an old man in a robe.

It is Jordanyang, who comes from the Immortal Realm.

"Master Wan, this is the person I am talking about."

Then, Wan Feng raised his eyebrows slightly and looked at Jordanyang in front of him.

Jordanyang was also looking at Wan Feng at this moment.

For a moment, neither of them spoke.

After a long time, Wanfeng asked first.

"You came from the fairyland?"

Upon hearing this, Jordan Yang was shocked, "How could you know?"

He was very sure that it was his first time meeting the woman in front of him. Even if he was famous, this was the Wood Fairy World. Could it be that his reputation had been passed down here?

Jordan Yang was puzzled.

But Wan Feng in front of him started to laugh.

"It seems that it's you."

Hearing this, Jordan Yang was confused, "What are you talking about?"

At this moment, Jordan Yang suddenly felt an ominous feeling.

And obviously, his feeling was right.

The next moment, a fierce fist slammed into his face.

"Eat me a punch first!"

Faced with this sudden fist, Jordan Yang never expected that the strange woman in front of him would suddenly take action, so he naturally couldn't resist it.

Bang!

With a loud bang, Jordanyang flew backwards.

A wailing sounded immediately.

"Well, this,"

Standing aside, Xun Heng was a little confused, "Wan, Lord Wan, why are you?"

Not only Jordan Yang was confused, but he was the same.

Could it be that this old man is really a liar and was discovered by Lord Wan?

However, Wan Feng did not answer him, but said indifferently: "You are not here anymore, you can retreat first, so as not to hurt you."

Upon hearing this, Xun Heng didn't dare to say anything more. He nodded quickly and left the scene immediately.

At this time, a cough came from afar.

"Ahem, you, why did you attack me?!"

Jordanyang struggled to get up, looking angry.

But at this moment, after being punched by Wan Feng, half of his face swollen, and the majestic wind was gone, and the face was replaced by a funny face.

Seeing this, Wan Feng couldn't help laughing.

"There is no reason to hit people."

Immediately, Wanfeng continued to rush towards Jordanyang.

Looking at the Anhui Feng rushing towards him again, Jordanyang was shocked and a nameless fire ignited in his heart.

It’s really a tiger falling into Pingyang and being bullied by a dog. I went to the top alchemist in the fairy realm, but I was beaten up when I came to such a small place.

That's okay.

Immediately, a powerful peak aura of the Immortal Emperor Realm surged out of Jordanyang's body.

If this aura is placed in other places, it will inevitably cause a stir, until the void is broken and the space is broken.

But now he is in the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

Not only did this aura not cause any threat, it was instantly suppressed by the terrifying power of the law in the city lord's mansion.

Suddenly, Jordanyang was stunned in place like a deflated balloon.

Immediately afterwards, another punch hit his eyes.

Bang!

A scream.

Jordan Yang flew backwards again.

But this time, Wanfeng did not stop, but directly bullied himself, and then he was unilaterally crushing and beating.

"Ah!! I am an alchemist!! How dare you take such a heavy move?!!"

"Alchemist? What I'm fighting is an alchemist!"

"Stop! Stop! Stop, I can help you refine elixirs!"

"Pill refinement? I don't want it even if I give it to you for free!"

No matter what Jordanyang said, it would be useless for Wanfeng.

In this way, it took me a long time to stop screaming.

Back in the courtyard, Wanfeng clapped his hands and then breathed a sigh of relief.

"Oh, I haven't been active for a long time, I'm quite tired."

Wanfeng hasn't felt this feeling of being fist-to-heart.

It's really, it's so cool!
